title: Jonathan Hager House and Museum

services.name: Ghost Tours
services.desc: Enjoy a guided walking tour exploring historic Hagerstown from the perspective of town founder, Jonathan Hager. Walking tour will lead from the Hager House to Zion Reformed Church and back highlighting downtown historic site and fun facts celebrating Washington County's 250th Anniversary! $5/person. Private group

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Visit the refurbished home of Hagerstown's founder, Jonathan Hager, built circa 1739. This one-of-a-kind house museum is staged with historic furniture and artifacts. Take a guided tour of the restored limestone homestead fortress built over a never-failing spring for an authentic educational heritage experience unlike any other.
